messages.subject: Mining, Energy & Infrastructure Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Sticklen,

Resourceful Recruitment's leadership work across mining, energy, utilities and infrastructure makes this a particularly relevant introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications within a major natural-resources operation, alongside renewable-energy and battery-storage investment.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments where resources and infrastructure growth depend on regulatory credibility, institutional relationships, stakeholder confidence and responsible development. I am internationally mobile, with Saudi Arabia and the UAE as priority markets alongside broader global opportunities.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for appropriate current or future searches.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
